name: Clockwork Guardian, Supercharged
body:
SUPERCHARGED CLOCKWORK GUARDIAN
CR 6

This ogre-sized figure crafted from metal is twitching slightly as arcane clockwork spins within. One hand is shaped into a fist, while the other is is formed from a serrated circular blade.

XP 2,400
N Large construct
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 16, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +3 natural, +2 dodge)
hp 63 (6d10+30)
Fort +5, Ref +10, Will +5
SR 16
Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 1 slam +10 (3d6+5), 1 spinning sawblade +10 (4d6+5) and special

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 16, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +4; CMB +4, CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spinning Saw-blade (Ex)

As per Clockwork Guardian – Normal but melee slashing +10 dealing 4d6+5 damage.
